descriptions.s19_release_ref_80023200: Appears to decrement the count at +8, call virtual slot 5 when it reaches zero and return the new count.
descriptions.s19_fire_once_8002ad9c: Appears to set the flag at +0x30 and call virtual slot 14 the first time it runs.
descriptions.s19_set_pose_8002e558: Appears to copy two three-float vectors into fields at +0x40 and +0x34 and set the word at +0x4c.
descriptions.s19_reset_cell_80022704: Appears to clear one word and set another in the referenced cell, then call its virtual slot 5.
